inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, curricular guidelines, FAQ, HELP, CONTRIBUTING, OSTEP course page, and extras

anchors.why: Defines summary, course selection criteria, curriculum organization, duration, cost, process, and stale-resource warnings.
Anchors curriculum design to ACM/IEEE CS2013 and notes CS2023 development.
Documents deprecated ecosystem materials and time-sensitive platform access changes.
Separates course-specific problems from general program problems and asks users to report prior attempts.
Separates non-substantive fixes from substantive curriculum proposals.
Adds base/extended route, prerequisites, environment warnings, and project guidance.
Keeps high-quality but non-fitting courses outside the main route.

known_limits: Course availability, pricing, and audit access are time-sensitive.
Curriculum tables are route guidance, not evidence for technical claims.
Community channels can help learners but do not establish truth confidence.
